title: Board Sizes
lede: Creative video staff need the exact pixel size of a venue board. The page now finds that board and copies the size, aspect ratio, and any safe area the sources already record.

stats.n: axe-core 4.10.3 default rules, light and dark, on the venue, board, search, content, agents, issues, and tools pages.
Every display and zone id in manifest 2026-10-09.1. No size was added or changed.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Before is the tools-branch snapshot at 55124f219bdfcd53bb54e270759eefd8c01d6733, because Board Sizes is not on main. After is this branch on top of main f59aee2a. Same Chrome headless settings, light appearance, manifest 2026-10-09.1, scroll at the top. The page does not render a clock.

pairs.title: Camp Randall, desktop
pairs.sub: 1440×900. Find a display, then copy its spec.
pairs.beforeCap: Several equal actions: JSON, CSV, link, and a size that copies only the pixel count.
pairs.afterCap: One primary action, Copy spec. CSV and the share link sit in More.

pairs.title: Camp Randall, phone
pairs.beforeCap: Browse opens the venue list. The size button is the only copy control on a card.
pairs.afterCap: Copy spec stays in the header. Browse still opens the list, and Escape closes it.

pairs.title: North Board, desktop
pairs.beforeCap: Copy actions are split across the header. Safe area is not in the copied size.
pairs.afterCap: Copy spec includes 5760×1440, 4:1, the speaker scrims, and 60.00 fps. Guide SVG and PNG are in More.

pairs.title: North Board, phone
pairs.beforeCap: The drawing and the zone list stack. Each row copies a bare size.
pairs.afterCap: Each row copies that zone's full spec. More holds the guide downloads.

pairs.title: Search for fascia
pairs.beforeCap: Search finds fascia boards. Filtering to one venue takes another click in the sidebar.
pairs.afterCap: Five fascia displays, with a chip for each venue that has a match. Copy spec is on every card.

changes.h: Copy the spec, not just the pixel count
changes.was: The size button copied 5760×1440. Aspect ratio, position, and safe area were somewhere else on the page.
changes.now: Copy spec writes the venue, board, size, aspect ratio, position, and only the safe area the manifest records. If none is recorded, the line says so.

changes.was: A downloaded guide was not one click away from the board.
changes.now: Guide SVG and Guide PNG are in More. The file is the board's exact width and height. A dashed inset is drawn only when a pad or title-safe inset is on file.

changes.h: The manifest is the only size source
changes.was: data.js, the CSV, the index, and the design notes could drift from boards.json.
changes.now: node scripts/build-board-sizes.mjs regenerates them. --check fails when they drift, when a board grows an unknown field, or when a script hash on the page is stale.

verification: node scripts/build-board-sizes.mjs --check: fresh. validateSchema and validateManifest reported no problems. No dimension in boards.json was edited.

axe-core 4.10.3 default rules: 0 violations on Camp Randall, North Board, fascia search, Kohl Center, Goodman, open issues, a content type, the agent page, and /tools, at 1440×900 and 390×844 where listed. The same two board pages were clean in dark mode.
Keyboard: / focuses search, Escape closes More and the phone venue list, Copy spec wrote the North Board spec (5760x1440, 4:1, speaker scrims, 60.00 fps).

npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false: clean after prisma generate. ESLint on tests/board-sizes.test.ts and next.config.ts: clean. npm run build:app: completed. npm run codemap:check: clean after the test-count update. git diff --check: clean.

Lighthouse was not run. axe-core's target-size rule is disabled by default; on a phone, some zones in the scaled North Board drawing are under 24px. The zone rows underneath are the 40px copy controls.
notes: Twelve open questions stay in the manifest. Kohl Center frame rate disagrees (Colosseum 60 vs the After Effects project 59.94) on the centerhung, 16:9 feed, top ring, 360 fascia, tunnels, scorer's table, stanchion, and baseline table. The 16:9 feed is also unconfirmed. The Field House table names are not final, and zone 8 is still labeled Left GIP-BG. Goodman main is 560×308 from Colosseum only.
Nothing was invented to fill those gaps. Zones without a position still have no position. The house 59.94 note in the design guide is guidance, not a recorded frame rate.
This is not deployed. AC-10 in the showroom area doc stays unchecked until /board-sizes and /tools are proven on the deployed site.
Open pull request 471 also adds a copy of this tool, plus Golden Hour and Timelapse, and points /tools at a signed-in /apps page. This branch does not include those other tools.
